Product Gallery is the photo area of a product page. On desktop a thumbnail rail sits beside the main image, or a row sits under it, and a ring slides to the chosen thumbnail. Picking a thumbnail crossfades the photo in place instead of sliding through every shot in between, and it waits for the new photo to decode so the frame never flashes empty.

The viewer is a modal dialog with a title. Focus starts on the image and returns to the chosen thumbnail on close. Videos never autoplay, and play only after a press, with native controls.

The viewer is a modal dialog. Arrows, swipes and thumbnails move between photos, and pinch, double-tap, click, the trackpad, the wheel and the + and − keys zoom and pan with soft edges. Swipe down to close, or press Escape, which first resets the zoom. Focus returns to the chosen thumbnail. With reduced motion, zoom and slide changes happen without animation.
The visible image carries its own alt text. Hidden slides are removed from the accessibility tree, and the visual counter is hidden because the tabs already say the position.
Videos also need a poster.
